title: SessionFrontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of `.workledger/sessions/<ulid>.md`. Written only by the CLI. Frozen at P1 Wave 0 (2026-09-09); `started_in` and `about` added, optional, by P8 amendment 10 (2026-09-10).

repo.description: First git remote's host/path without scheme or .git, else the directory basename.

checkpoint_failures.description: Times a block was followed by a failed checkpoint attempt and a retry that also failed.

started_in.description: Where the harness session was started — the directory its transcript is stored under and a resume runs in (P8 amendment 10). Never where the session is filed.

about.description: The repos the session is about, inferred from its transcript's tool inputs, best first (P8 amendment 10); this ledger's repo is one of them.

turns.description: Cumulative Stop events seen in this session at the time of the checkpoint; per-checkpoint deltas are derived by subtraction.

transcript_offset.description: Byte size of the transcript file when the checkpoint was recorded; the span for checkpoint n is [offset(n-1), offset(n)).

trigger.description: P1 emits bytes, minutes, turns, manual. The rest are reserved for P3 so the enum does not need a schema_version bump. Precedence when several thresholds cross at once: bytes, minutes, turns.

x-body.goal-form: - [cp <n>] <goal>; the Goal section holds exactly one line, replaced (not appended) whenever a payload carries a goal
x-body.section-order: Done and Remaining are newest-checkpoint-first; Notes is chronological; payload order is kept within one checkpoint
x-body.done-form: - [cp <n>] <text> files: <a>, <b> · commit: <hash> · verified: <v>; attributes in that order joined by ' · ' (U+00B7 with a space either side); files and commit omitted when absent; verified always present
x-body.remaining-form: - [cp <n>] → WL-<ulid> (new|updates|closes) <text>; why: <why>; then '; blocked_by: <ids joined by ", ">' only when the payload carries the key, 'none' when present and empty
x-body.note-form: - <type> [cp <n>]<' by <by>' for decisions>: <text><'; reason: <reason>' for decisions>
x-body.unparsed-lines: a line matching no form is preserved verbatim at the foot of its own section and exposed by the parser as unparsed[]; blank lines inside a section are structural and not preserved
x-body.amended: 2026-09-09 amendment 2: goal-form, section-order, done-form, remaining-form, unparsed-lines frozen from PR #22 golden files
